protocol_amendment.reason: The exact-commit V11 red-team review found five launch-boundary defects: accounting, reservation, and registered-curve cache state was shared across invocations; focused tests constructed transient frozen B4, B6, and B8 legacy semantic rows without complete scope disclosure; verification output used a check-then-replace publication sequence; internal unchecked and test entry points could be called without the path-only evidence boundary; and raw work charging accepted negative, Boolean, and non-integer amounts.
changes: Accept only the V12 document schema and reject V1-V11 without row verification.

Create one fresh verifier state for every public path-based verification call, bind that state to the current thread and asynchronous context, restore any outer state on return, and keep actual work, resource reservation, and registered-curve cache values inside that invocation.

Require an identity-checked process-local path permit in the active invocation state before any legacy-row, density-row, or V12 document semantic helper may execute; public direct row APIs remain disabled and production-module test wrappers may not create their own permit. Repository tests deliberately inject the internal sentinel through test-file introspection, remain non-evidence, and do not create an exported permit factory.
Validate every work charge at the mutation boundary as an exact positive integer and reject Boolean, zero, negative, float, and other amounts before changing a counter.

Replace output resolve-check-replace behavior with lexical containment below the development root, no-follow directory-descriptor traversal, an unpredictable exclusive temporary inode, complete checked writes and fsync, descriptor-relative atomic exclusive rename on macOS, an equivalent no-overwrite link-and-unlink path where supported, and an O_EXCL descriptor-bound direct-publication fallback on filesystems such as exFAT that support neither primitive; the fallback never overwrites, and an interrupted final write remains a fail-closed unaccepted path that must not be reused.

Add race controls proving that a destination created before publication is preserved, symlink directory components are rejected, pre-claim failure leaves no destination, and any interrupted exFAT direct-publication path is retained as unaccepted rather than overwritten.

Add concurrent and nested verification controls proving that each receipt, cache, completeness flag, and resource reservation is invocation-local and that an outer invocation is restored after a nested call.

Explicitly disclose the transient frozen B4, B6, and B8 legacy semantic rows used only to reproduce predecessor objective values; they are noncanonical test objects, not V12 curve-family density rows or evidence artifacts.

Retain the exact completed provenance and predicate vector 480 prime candidates, 112 draws, 336 curve hashes, 218 registered-curve point enumerations, and 4218 predicate hashes for a completed canonical matrix.
Keep every generated curve-family density-row and canonical run budget at zero.
unchanged_mathematical_boundary: The curve grid, predicates, four null replicates, representative compiler, ordering digest, graph object, cap schedule, five-field objective, matched-null thresholds, positive gate, and negative classification remain unchanged.
Exactness remains finite, TOY-EVIDENCE, and MODEL-BOUND to the fixed compiler and order-ideal construction.
The standalone complete five-field semantic oracle remains frozen-B4 only; transient B6 and B8 legacy controls reproduce predecessor values but are not independent five-field oracles.
No relation generation, rank, linear algebra, target descent, fixed-curve preprocessing crossover, rho comparison, exponent, deployment, or ECDLP result is in scope.
residual_external_resource_boundary: Context-local state prevents accidental concurrent and nested receipt corruption inside one process but is not a hostile same-process Python sandbox or executed-code attestation.

Descriptor-bound publication prevents overwrite and parent-symlink races below the development root. On exFAT the O_EXCL fallback can expose an incomplete destination during an interrupted write; validity requires a complete report hash and successful writer return, and the path must remain fail-closed rather than be overwritten.
The one-buffer snapshot and lexical preflight are not CPU, wall-time, peak-RSS, parser-object, allocator-retention, disk, I/O, cache-traffic, or memory-bandwidth guarantees.
Canonical B6 and B8 feasibility, serialized output size, cache occupancy, and role resource use remain unmeasured.
The module-load verifier digest is diagnostic only; a future runner must bind the exact commit, command, environment, immutable paths, hard process limits, and external resource receipts.
protocol_amendment.required_next_review: Validate and commit one exact V12 snapshot, then obtain fresh independent theory, accounting, and red-team review. Three scoped GO decisions could authorize only a separate hash-complete launch-plan design with hard external resource containment, not execution.
